card.text: Explore Menoetius, the companion of Patroclus, through its occultation-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Menoetius forms a binary system with Patroclus. This published ellipsoid combines stellar-occultation and light-curve constraints. Local shape deviations are unresolved; no crater or albedo pattern is reconstructed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Occultation shape approximation
model.summary: Published approximate ellipsoid with full dimensions 117×108×90 km, inferred from occultation and photometry. Orbital-pole alignment is a synchronous approximation; the display meridian is arbitrary. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
